name: RC-B10-0191/2024 – After § 19 – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
part_text: 19a. Strongly condemns the decision by the United States to provide anti-personnel mines to Ukraine, emphasising that such weapons violate international humanitarian principles and have catastrophic long-term effects on civilian populations; urges the EU to reaffirm its commitment to the Ottawa Treaty by ensuring that no Member State participates, directly or indirectly, in the deployment or transfer of these weapons; calls on all states, including the United States, Ukraine and Russia, to adhere to the principles of the Ottawa Treaty, to refrain from using these weapons and to work towards the universal eradication of anti-personnel mines;
